readings.text: A ferret barrels down three city tram lanes automatically while I swipe around barriers, duck under signs, and scoop up coins.
Make a toaster zoom through factory conveyor lanes on its own, with quick sideways swipes past presses and jumps for golden bolts.
This courier never stops charging down a desert route; I pick between three trails and leap over cacti to snag dates.
i get swept forward along three underwater channels and can only switch channels or duck beneath coral arches while grabbing pearls.
Let me steer a frog left and right across forest branches, choosing jumps between mushroom shelves without dropping into the ravine.
A miner needs careful sideways movement and little jumps between cave ledges, with deep pits underneath every badly judged landing.
Can a teapot climb across living room furniture if I control every step and jump, using floating cushions above the floor?
I want to move sideways through a ruined castle and jump between crumbling balconies, where missing a foothold sends me into the moat.
Guide a snail anywhere around a wide meadow while a salt golem pursues it, weaving around rocks until the rescue bell rings.
Let me wander freely around an abandoned factory yard gathering scattered screws, trying to clear the whole floor before lunch.
A duck is trapped in a jungle clearing with a crocodile chasing it; I steer in any direction and survive until sunrise.
Move a blacksmith freely around a graveyard and smack surrounding skeletons with a hammer until none are left standing.
Put a crab behind the wheel of a sand buggy and let me steer around beach flags to finish ahead of rival carts.
i steer my motorbike through a closed city circuit, braking for sharp corners and trying to beat the clock over three laps.
An astronaut has a tiny pod above a moon base; I pulse its thrusters against gravity and settle gently onto the marked pad.
Send an electrician around a dark supermarket, visiting each broken fuse box and fixing its wiring until every aisle lights up.
I walk between thirsty saplings in a forest nursery and water each one, finishing only when every planting bed has been tended.
An octopus runs a floating soup kiosk on the ocean, staying behind the counter to assemble each customer's bowl in order.

reading.setting: a floating soup kiosk on the ocean
reading.title: Floating Soup Kiosk

readings.text: A scarecrow guards a meadow by aiming a water cannon at incoming crows, spraying them before they reach the scarecrow's hat.
Give me a foam blaster in a closed mall so I can track rolling mannequins and keep firing until they topple.
A submarine mechanic aims a harpoon gun around an underwater workshop, firing at robot eels as they swim in from every side.
A raccoon gets one paper ball per attempt; I choose its angle and strength to arc it into a distant living room wastebasket.
I want one careful toss at a time, setting the angle and power to lob horseshoes around a stake beside a desert campsite.
Have a baker launch a single dough ball across a supermarket bakery, adjusting the arc and force to land inside a mixing bowl.
A giraffe builds a lookout in the jungle; tap when each swinging crate is centered above the pile to release it onto the top.
A locksmith opens a cave vault when I tap to halt a swinging gauge needle inside its tiny green patch, with faster sweeps each round.
Help a beetle cross meadow posts by holding to extend a reed and releasing when it's long enough to fall across the next gap.
A drummer robot performs in a factory, and I tap glowing pads as notes reach them in time with the clanking soundtrack.
Let me tap arriving shell symbols right on the music's pulse during a beach concert, with longer streaks making the crowd cheer.
A jellyfish lights up an ocean disco whenever I press the correct bubbles as musical cues arrive, keeping every tap synced to the bass.
A knight faces one ogre in a snowy courtyard; I watch its shoulder movements, block each axe swing, and counter during openings.
I arm wrestle a pirate at a seaside tavern, reading their grip changes and choosing when to resist or push back.
Let a mantis fence against a single wasp on a forest stump, reacting to feints with parries and well timed lunges.
Keep a bat airborne through a cave tunnel with little upward boosts per tap, letting it sink between stalactites as it flies forward automatically.
i drift forward through a space station automatically, tapping for tiny lifts against gravity to squeeze between paired cargo shutters.
A flying sock sails forward across a living room by itself; every tap lifts it briefly before gravity pulls it toward the furniture gaps.
Slide a shopping basket sideways beneath a broken supermarket chute, collecting falling oranges while letting rotten eggs hit the floor.
I move left and right beneath jungle trees to gather falling mangoes in my hands, staying clear of the dropping scorpions.
A seal slides across a snowy dock beneath falling fish, and I steer sideways to collect dinner while avoiding heavy anchors.
A gardener taps mischievous moles with a rubber mallet whenever they briefly poke out of meadow burrows, before they disappear again.
Let me bonk tiny ghosts that peek out of graveyard urns for a second, with points only if I get them before they retreat.
A bellhop patrols one screen of hotel windows, tapping gremlins the instant they lean out and before they slam the shutters.
A beekeeper protects a meadow hive by placing thorn barricades and guard beetles along paths before successive groups of hungry hornets arrive.
I protect a desert well by setting cactus sentries around its approaches, rearranging them between waves of thirsty sand worms.
A mermaid keeps an underwater hatchery safe by placing anemone guards along the routes used by repeated swarms of hungry piranhas.
A chef swipes a blade through airborne cabbages tossed across a castle kitchen, building combos while leaving the flying iron kettles untouched.
i swipe through floating soap bubbles launched above a mall fountain, cutting several together but keeping my finger away from spiky mines.
A swordfish cuts airborne kelp bundles with my swipes over an ocean lagoon, avoiding explosive barrels mixed into every volley.
A tortoise crosses a city boulevard one row per tap, waiting for openings between buses before taking the next little step.
I cross a factory shipping floor one strip at a time, choosing when to step between passing forklifts and rolling cable reels.
Guide a llama across snowy resort lanes with single forward steps, waiting out speeding sleds before entering each new row.
Lead a marching pencil army through numbered gates that add or subtract pencils, then crash the surviving squad into hostile erasers on a classroom desk.
I guide my squad through +15 and divide by two gates along a space hangar, building enough bodies to overwhelm alien guards at the end.
A marshmallow leads its sugary troops through numbered multiplying or subtracting arches in a supermarket, then the whole group collides with licorice monsters.
A squirrel drops acorns onto a forest tray where identical pairs fuse into larger nuts, and I need to keep the tray from overflowing.
I slide pebbles around a cave board, combining two identical stones into one larger crystal each time before every space gets clogged.
Let an alchemist drop potions into a desert tray, where two identical bottles become one stronger brew and a full tray ends the attempt.
A walrus shoves rival sea lions off a small ice floe, and I steer each body bump while keeping away from the slippery edge.
I shoulder charging gargoyles off a narrow castle rooftop, trying to send every opponent over the edge without getting knocked down myself.
Control a bumper car on a floating factory deck, ramming rogue shopping carts over the sides while keeping all four wheels aboard.
A tortoise in running shoes builds a pile in the mall by tapping to drop each shoebox sliding overhead directly onto the last.
A photographer handles a mall photo shoot from one counter, cropping pictures and printing the requested sizes for a nonstop queue of customers.
A chimney sweep beneath a castle tower roams the wide courtyard freely while an angry goose chases him, trying to survive until the bell rings.
At beach catch practice, you swipe through airborne melons to chop them apart while leaving flying anvils untouched.
A penguin wearing fake wings explores a cave by moving left or right and jumping between rocky shelves, losing a life whenever it falls.
In a castle, a baker guards a cake by tapping four buttons exactly with the drumbeat, earning points only for staying on beat.
A mechanic fixes a race car by repeatedly stopping a needle sweeping back and forth inside a tiny green band, with closer stops earning more points.
You wander anywhere across a meadow scooping up scattered golf balls, scoring one point per ball in your bag.
A crab in boxing gloves crosses rows of beach traffic one step per tap, waiting for safe openings between passing buggies.
A librarian settles a book fight by sliding identical books together on a grid so they become bigger volumes before the board fills.
A fox pilots a drum-shaped rocket over a volcano, feathering its upward thrust and steering sideways until its feet settle softly onto each pad.
An octopus waves eight swords around an underwater courtyard; steer anywhere and slash nearby eels until every eel is down.
An astronaut in jump boots walks between broken moon base antennas, reconnecting wires at each one until all antennas work.
A sheep leads a painted cardboard army automatically along three forest lanes; switch lanes or duck to avoid hanging branches and grab acorns.
To escape a jungle temple, you answer geography questions by choosing one of four answers, and each correct answer unlocks the next question.
A beaver builds a bridge across an ocean by solving anagrams, typing one rearranged word per plank while the construction happens automatically.
A witch defends her castle's reputation by choosing polite or savage replies in text conversations with a nosy florist, changing their friendship score.
A snail enters a desert race where each turn you play a numbered card, and the lowest total after five cards wins.
A crocodile prepares for a laser shootout by choosing jackets, boots, and hats from a wardrobe, then submitting outfits for style scores.
An owl manages a flying school by assigning instructors to weekly calendar slots, resolving schedule conflicts to earn a perfect timetable.
